summary: Iteration 1 — Absenlah backend + frontend E2E tested. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass after fixing 2 bugs (ObjectId serialization in create_user/create_warehouse, invalid dtime.replace(year=) dead code in check-out). Frontend: login (Indonesian), language toggle (ID/EN), force change-password redirect, tabs home with clock/GPS/monthly-summary card, admin rules screen, admin panel in profile — all render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport.

critical.issue: Returned doc contained MongoDB ObjectId (_id) → 500 TypeError 'ObjectId object is not iterable' during JSON serialization. FIXED by popping _id after insert_one.
Same ObjectId serialization 500. FIXED by popping _id.

Dead code branch called dtime.replace(year=now.year) on a time object → TypeError 'year' is invalid keyword for replace(). FIXED by removing the dead branch (was gated by `and False` but Python still evaluates it).

minor.issue: Admin seed is idempotent (only inserts if missing) but doesn't reset must_change_password flag on subsequent test runs. Once admin changes password, subsequent test runs can't use admin123. Consider adding a dev-only reset endpoint or a seed refresh script.
Uses deprecated FastAPI on_event startup handler. Recommend migrating to lifespan context manager.
ConfigIn Pydantic model discards unknown fields but does not validate late_tiers/overtime_tiers item shape (accepts arbitrary Dict). Non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab buttons in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx have no testID props on Tabs.Screen. Testing had to rely on visible label text.

issues: GPS on web preview returns 'Lokasi Tidak Valid' — expected, but ensure fallback UX (link 'Buka Pengaturan') doesn't leave user stuck in web preview. Native only.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/kit.tsx (shadow-related styles).
props.pointerEvents deprecated warning surfaces in browser console. Non-blocking.
Console warns 'useNativeDriver is not supported' on web — cosmetic, cannot be fully avoided on Expo web preview.

action_items: Add testID props to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (e.g. tab-index, tab-attendance) for reliable e2e coverage.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/ui/kit.tsx to silence RN web deprecation.
Consider replacing FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') with the lifespan context manager (FastAPI ≥0.93).
Consider tightening Pydantic validation of late_tiers/overtime_tiers items (typed sub-models) to prevent malformed rules.
Optional: expose an admin-only 'reset admin password' or dev seed endpoint to make repeat testing easier.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py had two ObjectId leak spots (create_user, create_warehouse). Existing pattern uses `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one — now consistently applied everywhere.

check_out contained a dead `if ... and False:` branch that called dtime.replace(year=...) which is not supported on datetime.time. Removed; logic now: leaving before configured earliest (17:00) always deducts, else exceeding monthly limit deducts.
server.py is 1038 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, attendance, leave, config, admin) for maintainability.
startup_seed inserts DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy() with an updated_at captured at import time; fine, but note the timestamp will reflect module-load time rather than seed-time.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed create_user _id pop, create_warehouse _id pop, check_out dead code)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; tab navigation confirmed via text; testIDs missing on tabs)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test suite creates ephemeral TEST_ warehouse/user and deletes them within the same test class. Admin password was left as 'admin1234' after the frontend flow test — reset to admin123 in DB before next iteration if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If admin login fails, reset via DB: db.users.update_one({'username':'administrator'}, {'$set': {'password_hash': bcrypt('admin123'), 'must_change_password': True}}). Before running attendance tests, clean today's records for budi: db.attendance.delete_many({'user_id': <budi_id>}). Frontend testIDs to prioritize adding: tab-*.
rca_of_issue: 1) ObjectId 500: motor's insert_one() mutates the input document adding _id ObjectId; returning the doc directly causes FastAPI's default json encoder to fail. Mitigation: pop('_id', None) or refetch with projection {'_id': 0}. 2) check-out 500: A leftover exploratory branch `if <expr>.replace(year=now.year).replace() and False` evaluates the LHS at runtime; since parse_hhmm returns datetime.time (not datetime.datetime), .replace(year=...) raises TypeError. Mitigation: removed dead branch entirely.
